Doom shareware data notice
==========================

The embedded game data is the unmodified Doom 1.9 shareware episode from
id Software, Inc. It remains subject to id Software's shareware terms and is
separate from the GPL-licensed Doom engine source.

The pinned upstream build names this WAD source URL:
https://distro.ibiblio.org/slitaz/sources/packages/d/doom1.wad

That shortcut now returns HTTP 404. The reproducible build retrieves the same
unmodified Doom 1.9 shareware WAD from Debian's archival source package:
https://deb.debian.org/debian/pool/non-free/d/doom-wad-shareware/doom-wad-shareware_1.9.fixed.orig.tar.gz

The embedded WAD is 4,196,020 bytes and has SHA-256 digest:
1d7d43be501e67d927e415e0b8f3e29c3bf33075e859721816f652a526cac771
